title: Deeply nested Loop
description: Performance rule — scripts with three or more nested Loops. Nested iteration multiplies the work per outer pass.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Triple-nested loops scale poorly; the inner body runs O(n³) times.
rule.remediation: Flatten the iteration with a relationship / ExecuteSQL join, or precompute the inner set.
